## Problem and change

Describe the problem and the focused change. Link the Dibbur issue, if there is one.

## Testing

- OS and architecture:
- Commands run and results:
- Manual checks, where relevant: recording, model loading, Hebrew/Arabic, shortcut, paste, permissions, packaging and update behavior:
- Not tested / known limits:

## Review checklist

- [ ] I searched [Dibbur issues](https://github.com/ofershap/dibbur/issues) and [pull requests](https://github.com/ofershap/dibbur/pulls), including closed ones.
- [ ] I read [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/ofershap/dibbur/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md).
- [ ] The change contains no credentials, signing material, private recordings or transcripts.
- [ ] I kept upstream attribution and license notices.

## AI assistance

If AI tools helped, name them and describe what you checked. AI-assisted contributions are welcome and need the same test evidence as other contributions.
